h: BREAKING: INEC denies claims chairman Amupitan is planning to resign
p: The Independent National Electoral Commission has denied claims that its chairman, Professor Joash Amupitan, is planning to resign, dismissing the reports ahead of the 2027 general elections.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has denied claims that its chairman, Professor Joash Amupitan, is planning to resign.
The commission dismissed the reports, which had been circulating ahead of the 2027 general elections, and maintained that the chairman is not stepping down.

Any change at the top of the electoral body this close to a general election would raise serious concerns about preparations for the polls. INEC has faced intense scrutiny in recent weeks, including controversy over AI-generated images in the voter register and growing tension around the "Rig and Die" slogan.
More details are expected as the story develops.
Do you believe the INEC chairman will remain in office until the 2027 elections?
more: INEC says its chairman is not planning to resign.
Professor Joash Amupitan heads the commission.
